{{Top|leg}}
'''Bambooi''' was a thick-bodied reed native to the lush swamplands of [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]], where it grew in dense thickets. Bambooi was exceedingly invasive and fast-growing, and was known to wipe out all other forms of vegetation in its path.<ref name="FP">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref>
